contract: ../docs/design-contract.md; authoritative repository blueprint. Local application security workspace with Canvas, linked Guard evidence, truthful Sentinel outcomes, and preview-only notifications.

accessibility.evidence: Chromium axe WCAG 2 A/AA and 2.1 AA checks found no violations on Overview/Canvas at each target width, dark Overview, and six additional representative screens. Browser tests exercised direct node Enter selection, dialog Escape/focus restoration, and mobile menu navigation. Reduced-motion styles and graph animation preference are implemented. Full screen-reader testing is not claimed.

responsive.evidence: Measured no document overflow on Overview and Canvas at all three target widths. Reviewed saved desktop, narrow desktop, dark and phone captures. Phone Canvas offers a structured component list and suppresses graph-only controls. Desktop navigation exposes all groups at target height.

loading.evidence: Interaction scenario observed the disabled Running demo simulation button and captured scan-loading-1440.png before the simulated scan completed.

empty.evidence: Reset walkthrough confirmed notifications return to Your previews will appear here; initial Sentinel shows an explained no-incidents state.

error.evidence: Staging form rejected an unauthorized non-test hostname with an accessible inline error; valid explicitly authorized .test scope then saved successfully.

partial.evidence: Sentinel and workspace coverage show synthetic detection separately from unconnected telemetry, simulated enforcement and unavailable real delivery. Verified outcomes are scope-limited.

success.evidence: Primary walkthrough passed synthetic remediation/retest, separately verified incident outcome, paired notification previews, archive, explicit draft-rule approval and deterministic reset.

permission.evidence: GitLab onboarding required acknowledging a demo-only connection and explained future read-only grants. Staging authorization was required. Draft rule approval required explicit review confirmation. No real OAuth success was asserted.

renderedEvidence.observation: Light workspace with operational summary, application map, next actions, full navigation and coverage boundary.
Narrow desktop preserves readable hierarchy and two-column overview without document overflow.
Phone replaces the graph with keyboard and touch-selectable component rows; graph-only controls are suppressed.
Complete dark surfaces, legible muted text, restrained semantic severity and provenance.
Selected Orders API displays its evidence origin and linked FIND-102; directed relationships use distinct attachment points.
